visual_action: Donald Trump disembarks from a plane labeled "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" onto a red carpet on an airport tarmac. He is greeted by a line of people in colorful, traditional attire who appear to be performing a ceremonial welcome dance. Trump shakes hands with one individual and then waves and interacts with the dancers. The video concludes with a black and white logo card for "THE WHITE HOUSE" over an image of the building, followed by a shot of a helicopter.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the central figure in the video, shown arriving at an airport and being greeted. On-screen text reads 'President Trump has ARRIVED in Malaysia'.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video ends with a logo card featuring an image of the building and the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE'. The post is from the @whitehouse account.
